narr: Strong storms moved through southern New England overnight bringing a line of very strong winds, some flash flooding, and two tornados to Massachusetts.
ev: In Worcester, Rt 20 near Grafton St was flooded with vehicles stranded in flood water.
In Framingham, a section of Rt 9 near Natick was flooded with 1 foot of water.
In Boston, an underpass was flooded at Columbia Rd and Ceylon St.
In West Roxbury, 3 cars were stuck in floodwaters on Spring St.
